newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY LEAGUE-ST HELENS WIN ENGLISH RUGBY LEAGUE CHALLENGE CUP.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY LEAGUE-ST HELENS WIN ENGLISH RUGBY LEAGUE CHALLENGE CUP.

text.p: St Helens beat Bradford Bulls 32-22 (halftime 16-10) in the English Rugby league Challenge Cup final at Wembley on Saturday.
St Helens - Tries: Tommy Martyn (2), Karle Hammond, Chris Joynt, Anthony Sullivan. Penalties: Bobbie Goulding (2). Conversions: Bobbie Goulding (4)
Bradford - Tries: Danny Peacock, Paul Loughlin, Glen Tomlinson, James Lowes. Conversions: Steve McNamara (3).
